security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https: http: ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.longDescription: A cross-platform desktop workbench for the sparq RDF + SPARQL engine. A DISTINCT operational frontend (left rail · tab strip · status bar) — not the marketing site in a window — running a live in-tab engine. The same frontend also static-exports as a hosted 'Try the GUI live' web target.
